display.attractionName: Under the Sea: Journey of The Little Mermaid

description: During the big under-the-sea song scene, several pieces of purple coral are arranged as a classic three-circle Hidden Mickey, with two on the floor and one on the wall. The scene is bright, busy, and spinning with dancing sea creatures, which is exactly why the coral goes unnoticed.

whereToLook.scene: The scene where the crab sings the under-the-sea song
whereToLook.exactSpot: Purple corals: two on the floor and one on the wall, together forming the classic shape.

bestTip: Look low as the song starts, then let your eyes rise. The shape spans more than one spot.
